abilities.name: Battle Stance
abilities.desc: A balanced combat stance.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.desc: Charge an enemy, generate 15 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec. Cannot be used in combat.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.desc: Maims the enemy, causing 45 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 50% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Heroic Strike
abilities.desc: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 157 and causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Mocking Blow
abilities.desc: A mocking attack that causes 93 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Mortal Strike
abilities.desc: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 160 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Overpower
abilities.desc: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 35. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.desc: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 147 damage over 21 sec.

abilities.name: Retaliation
abilities.desc: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec. Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked. A maximum of 30 attacks will cause retaliation.

abilities.name: Spearing Strike
abilities.desc: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage. Deals an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

abilities.name: Sweeping Strikes
abilities.desc: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.desc: Blasts nearby enemies with thunder, increasing the time between their attacks by 20% for 30 sec and doing 103 damage to them. Will affect up to 4 targets.

abilities.name: Victory Rush
abilities.desc: Instantly attack the target causing 15% of Attack Power damage and healing you for 10% of your maximum health. Only useable within 20 sec after you kill a non-trivial enemy.

abilities.name: Battle Shout
abilities.desc: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 20 yards by 139. Lasts 3 min.

abilities.name: Berserker Rage
abilities.desc: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

abilities.name: Berserker Stance
abilities.desc: An aggressive stance. Critical strike chance increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.

abilities.name: Bloodthirst
abilities.desc: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 48 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Challenging Shout
abilities.desc: Forces all nearby enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.desc: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 50 to the target and a second nearby enemy.

abilities.name: Death Wish
abilities.desc: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Demoralizing Shout
abilities.desc: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 204 for 45 sec.

abilities.name: Execute
abilities.desc: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 600 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 15 additional damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

abilities.name: Intercept
abilities.desc: Charge an enemy, causing 65 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Intimidating Shout
abilities.desc: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear. Up to 5 enemies within 8 yds will flee in fear. Lasts 8 sec.

abilities.name: Piercing Howl
abilities.desc: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Pummel
abilities.desc: Pummel the target for 50 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Recklessness
abilities.desc: The warrior will gain 100% increased critical strike chance and will be immune to Fear effects for the next 15 sec, but all damage taken is increased by 20%.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.desc: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 87.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.desc: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.

abilities.name: Bloodrage
abilities.desc: Generates 10 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.

abilities.name: Concussion Blow
abilities.desc: Stuns the target for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Defensive Stance
abilities.desc: A defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%. Increases all threat generated by 30%.

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.desc: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.desc: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

abilities.name: Revenge
abilities.desc: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 138 to 168 damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.desc: Bashes the target with your shield for 45 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.desc: Increases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks.

abilities.name: Shield Slam
abilities.desc: Slam the target with your shield, causing 640 to 670 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.desc: Reduces the damage taken from all attacks by 60% for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Sunder Armor
abilities.desc: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 450 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.desc: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

abilities.name: Throw
abilities.desc: Hurl a thrown weapon at the target.

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.desc: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shatter Curse
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.desc: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.desc: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Cultivation
abilities.desc: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once. In play it goes on a 15 min cooldown, though its tooltip shows none.

abilities.name: Berserking
abilities.desc: Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Rapid Regeneration
abilities.desc: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Skysight
abilities.desc: Increases your movement speed by 15% for 15 sec. Used at an elemental convergence it also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 30%. Charged persists through death and ends when you enter a raid.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.desc: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Stun effects.

abilities.name: Find Treasure
abilities.desc: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap.  Lasts until canceled.

abilities.name: Stoneform
abilities.desc: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.desc: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

abilities.name: Elune's Light
abilities.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Escape Artist
abilities.desc: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.desc: For 8 sec, your non-periodic damaging abilities cost 10% less (Mana, Rage or Energy) and deal 10% more damage. For Priests, your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities cost 10% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Periodic effects get nothing from it; a channeled spell is not periodic. The Mage's own tooltip is the one that leaves out non-periodic.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Read Leyline
abilities.desc: Increases your Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. Used at a Ley Line it also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 100%. Attuned persists through death and ends when you enter a raid. Cannot be used while Innervate is active.
